labels: one universal node label and one universal edge label; original attributes unused
selection: shuffle all size-eligible nonempty graphs before predictions; take first 200 distinct graph indices
primary_metric: common edges divided by analytic planted optimum (target edge count)
exact_recovery: attains optimum edge count, independent of mapping automorphisms
timing: same Core interval as IMDB: synchronized forward, Hungarian, CPU mapping transfer and hard scoring; report ACG construction separately; one untimed warmup per arm/checkpoint/dataset; alternate arm order by graph rank plus seed

statistics.primary: paired graph bootstrap with independent resampling of three frozen training seeds; each dataset reported separately
